title: Tugallangan zamon va tajriba
goal_uz: Dars oxirida present perfect’ni natija va hayot tajribasi uchun to‘g‘ri ishlatasiz, for va since, just, already va yet so‘zlarini o‘z o‘rnida qo‘llaysiz hamda hayotingizdagi o‘zgarishlar haqida gapira olasiz.

scenes.title: Tugallangan zamon va tajriba
scenes.say: Hello again! Last time we drew the whole tense map. Today we study one zone of it in depth: the present perfect, for experience and results.
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda barcha zamonlarni bitta xaritaga joyladik va ma’noga qarab tanlashni mashq qildik. Bugun shu xaritadagi eng nozik joyni chuqur o‘rganamiz — present perfect. O‘zbek tilida bunga aniq mos zamon yo‘q, shuning uchun u ko‘pchilikka qiyin tuyuladi. Dars oxirida o‘z tajribangiz va hayotingizdagi o‘zgarishlar haqida to‘g‘ri gapira olasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Salom! Oldingi darsda butun zamonlar xaritasini chizdik. Bugun present perfect’ni, ya’ni tajriba va natija uchun ishlatilishini o‘rganamiz.

scenes.title: Shakli: have / has + V3
board: I / you / we / they + have + V3
Inkor: haven't / hasn't. Savol: Have you ...?

examples.t: She has bought a new car.

scenes.say: I have finished my work. She has bought a new car. Have they arrived? We form it with have or has and the past participle.
scenes.say_native: Present perfect — have yoki has va fe’lning uchinchi shakli, ya’ni past participle. I, you, we, they bilan “have”, he, she, it bilan “has”. Inkorda haven’t yoki hasn’t, savolda esa have yoki has gap boshiga chiqadi. Past participle muntazam fe’llarda -ed bilan tugaydi, masalan finished. Tartibsiz fe’llarni yodlash kerak: buy — bought, go — gone, see — seen.
scenes.say_uz: Men ishimni tugatdim. U yangi mashina sotib olgan. Ular yetib keldimi? Biz have yoki has va past participle’dan foydalanamiz.

scenes.title: Tartibsiz fe’llarning V3 shakli

examples.uz: Men u filmni ikki marta ko‘rganman.

scenes.say: Go, went, gone. See, saw, seen. Do, did, done. Write, wrote, written. Eat, ate, eaten. Learn the third form with the verb.
scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p kerak bo‘ladigan tartibsiz fe’llarni eslang. Go — went — gone. See — saw — seen. Do — did — done. Write — wrote — written. Eat — ate — eaten. Muhim farq: past simple va past participle ko‘pincha har xil. “I went” deymiz, lekin “I have gone” emas, “I have been” ishlatamiz, agar qaytib kelgan bo‘lsak. Buni birozdan keyin ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say_uz: Go, went, gone. See, saw, seen. Do, did, done. Write, wrote, written. Eat, ate, eaten. Uchinchi shaklni fe’l bilan birga yodlang.

scenes.title: V3 shaklini ayting
scenes.say: Give the past participle. Take. Speak. Come. Know.
scenes.say_native: Fe’llarning uchinchi shaklini ayting. Take, speak, come, know. Har birini “I have” bilan boshlang, masalan “I have taken”. Shunda shakl xotirada mustahkam o‘rnashadi.
scenes.say_uz: Uchinchi shaklni ayting. Take. Speak. Come. Know.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: Taken. Spoken. Come. Known. Note that come stays the same.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: take — taken, speak — spoken, come — come, know — known. Diqqat qiling: “come” ning uchinchi shakli o‘zgarmaydi, “come — came — come”. “I have comed” deyish xato. Bunday fe’llarni alohida yodlang.
scenes.say_uz: Taken. Spoken. Come. Known. Come o‘zgarmaydi.

scenes.title: Birinchi vazifa: natija
board: I've lost my keys. (= hozir yo‘q)
She's broken her leg. (= hozir gips)

examples.uz: U oyog‘ini sindirib olgan (hozir ham shunday).

scenes.say: I've lost my keys, so I can't get in. She has broken her leg, so she can't walk. The taxi has arrived, so let's go.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi vazifa — natija. Voqea o‘tmishda bo‘lgan, lekin uning ta’siri hozir ham ko‘rinib turibdi. “I’ve lost my keys” desam, kalitlar hozir ham yo‘q. “She has broken her leg” — oyog‘i hozir ham shikastlangan. Gapda voqea qachon bo‘lgani emas, hozirgi holat muhim. O‘zbekchada “yo‘qotib qo‘ydim”, “sindirib olibdi” deymiz, ya’ni “-ib qo‘y”, “-gan” kabi shakllar shunga yaqin.
scenes.say_uz: Kalitlarimni yo‘qotib qo‘ydim, shuning uchun kira olmayman. U oyog‘ini sindirgan, shuning uchun yura olmaydi. Taksi keldi, ketdik.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi vazifa: hayot tajribasi
board: Have you ever ...? — Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.

examples.t: Have you ever been to Italy?

scenes.say: Have you ever been to Italy? Yes, I have. I've never eaten sushi. I've met her before. We do not say when.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi vazifa — hayot tajribasi. Butun hayotingiz davomida nima qilgansiz yoki qilmagansiz. Bu yerda vaqt aytilmaydi, tajribaning o‘zi muhim. “Ever” savolda — hech, “never” — hech qachon. Savol: “Have you ever been to Italy?” Javob: “Yes, I have” yoki “No, I haven’t”. O‘zbekchada “Italiyada bo‘lganmisiz?” desak, “-gan” shakli ishlatiladi, bu juda mos keladi.
scenes.say_uz: Siz hech Italiyada bo‘lganmisiz? Ha, bo‘lganman. Men hech qachon sushi yemaganman. Men u bilan avval uchrashganman. Qachon bo‘lgani aytilmaydi.

scenes.title: Been va gone
board: has been to = borgan va QAYTIB KELGAN
has gone to = ketgan, hali U YERDA yoki yo‘lda
scenes.say: I've been to Paris twice. Tom has gone to Paris, so he is not here now. Where have you been?
scenes.say_native: Ikki muhim fe’l shakli. “Have been to” — borib qaytgan, tajriba. “Have gone to” — ketgan va hali qaytmagan. “I’ve been to Paris” — Parijda bo‘lganman, endi bu yerdaman. “Tom has gone to Paris” — Tom hozir Parijda yoki yo‘lda. Shuning uchun “Where have you been?” so‘rasak, bu odam qaytib kelgan. Bu farqni o‘zbek tiliga so‘zma-so‘z o‘girib bo‘lmaydi.
scenes.say_uz: Men Parijda ikki marta bo‘lganman. Tom Parijga ketgan, shuning uchun hozir bu yerda yo‘q. Qayerda bo‘ldingiz?

scenes.title: Vaqt ko‘rsatilsa past simple
board: ✗ I have been to Rome in 2019.
scenes.say: Not: I have been to Rome in 2019. If you say when, use the past simple: I went to Rome in 2019.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi katta xato: aniq vaqt bilan present perfect ishlatish. “I have been to Rome in 2019” — xato. Chunki 2019 tugagan, aniq vaqt. Agar vaqtni aytsangiz, past simple kerak: “I went to Rome in 2019”. Agar vaqtni aytmasangiz, present perfect: “I’ve been to Rome”. O‘zbekchada “2019 yilda Rimda bo‘lganman” deyish mumkin, lekin inglizchada bu mumkin emas.
scenes.say_uz: Noto‘g‘ri: I have been to Rome in 2019. Vaqt bo‘lsa, past simple: I went to Rome in 2019.

scenes.title: Tajriba haqida savollar
board: 4) Tom ... (go) to Paris. He isn't here.
scenes.say: Complete. One: have you ever, eat, sushi? Two: I never, see, snow. Three: she, go, to Rome in 2019. Four: Tom, go, to Paris. He isn't here.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapni to‘ldiring. Birinchisida tajriba savoli. Ikkinchisida never. Uchinchisida 2019 — aniq vaqt, ehtiyot bo‘ling. To‘rtinchisida Tom hozir bu yerda yo‘q — been yoki gone? Javobni baland ovoz bilan ayting.
scenes.say_uz: To‘ldiring. Bir: sushi yeganmisiz? Ikki: hech qachon qor ko‘rmaganman. Uch: u 2019 yilda Rimga borgan. To‘rt: Tom Parijga ketgan, u bu yerda yo‘q.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: One: have you ever eaten sushi. Two: I have never seen snow. Three: she went to Rome in 2019. Four: Tom has gone to Paris.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir — “eaten”. Ikki — “have never seen”. Uch — “went”, chunki 2019 aniq vaqt. To‘rt — “has gone”, chunki Tom hali qaytmagan. Uchinchisida xato qilgan bo‘lsangiz, qoidani eslang: aniq vaqt bo‘lsa, past simple.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: eaten. Ikki: have never seen. Uch: went. To‘rt: has gone.

scenes.title: For va since
board: for + MUDDAT: for five years, for two hours
since + BOSHLANISH NUQTASI: since 2019, since Monday

examples.t: I've lived here for five years.
examples.uz: Men bu yerda besh yildan beri yashayman.
Men bu yerda 2019 yildan beri yashayman.

examples.t: How long have you known him?

scenes.say: I've lived here for five years. I've lived here since 2019. How long have you known him? For is a period, since is a starting point.
scenes.say_native: Endi davomiylik. “For” dan keyin muddat keladi: for five years, for two hours. “Since” dan keyin boshlanish nuqtasi: since 2019, since Monday, since I was a child. Ikkalasi ham hozirgacha davom etgan holatni bildiradi va present perfect talab qiladi. Savol: “How long have you known him?” — qancha vaqtdan beri. O‘zbekchada bu yerda hozirgi zamon: “yashayman”, shuning uchun xato ko‘p.
scenes.say_uz: Men bu yerda besh yildan beri yashayman. Men bu yerda 2019 yildan beri yashayman. Uni qancha vaqtdan beri bilasiz? For muddat, since boshlanish nuqtasi.

scenes.title: For yoki since? Tez usul
board: Sana, kun, soat, voqea → since (Monday, 8 o'clock)
since I was ten / since we met

examples.t: She's been ill since last week.

scenes.say: For three days, since Tuesday. For ages, since breakfast. She has been ill since last week.
scenes.say_native: Tez usul. Agar “uch kun”, “ikki soat” kabi uzunlik aytilsa, “for” ishlating. Agar “seshanba”, “soat sakkiz”, “o‘tgan hafta”, “biz uchrashganimizdan beri” kabi nuqta aytilsa, “since”. Eslab qoling: “for” — nechchi vaqt, “since” — qachondan. Bu yerda ham fe’l present perfect bo‘ladi.
scenes.say_uz: Uch kundan beri, seshanbadan beri. Anchadan beri, nonushtadan beri. U o‘tgan haftadan beri kasal.

scenes.title: Davomli shakl: have been doing
board: I've been waiting for an hour.

examples.t: I've been waiting for an hour.
She has been learning English since June.
examples.uz: U iyundan beri ingliz tilini o‘rganyapti.

scenes.say: I've been waiting for an hour. She has been learning English since June. It's been raining all day.
scenes.say_native: Davomiylikni present perfect continuous bilan ham aytish mumkin: have been va fe’l-ing. “I’ve been waiting for an hour” — bir soatdan beri kutyapman, jarayonning o‘zi va uzunligi ta’kidlanadi. Know, like, have (egalik) kabi holat fe’llari bilan simple ishlatiladi: “I’ve known him for years”. Simple bilan continuous o‘rtasidagi farqni keyinroq ham ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say_uz: Bir soatdan beri kutyapman. U iyundan beri ingliz tilini o‘rganyapti. Kun bo‘yi yomg‘ir yog‘yapti.

scenes.title: Hozirgi zamon emas
board: ✗ I know him for ten years. → ✓ I've known him for ten years.
scenes.say: Not: I live here since 2019. Say: I've lived here since 2019. Not: I know him for ten years. Say: I've known him for ten years.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi katta xato: for va since bilan hozirgi zamon. O‘zbekchada “2019 yildan beri yashayman” desak, fe’l hozirgi zamonda, inglizcha esa present perfect: “I’ve lived here since 2019”. Xuddi shunday: “uni o‘n yildan beri bilaman” — “I’ve known him for ten years”, “I know” emas. Buni avtomatik qilish uchun “beri” so‘zini eshitsangiz, “have” deb o‘ylang.
scenes.say_uz: Noto‘g‘ri: I live here since 2019. To‘g‘risi: I've lived here since 2019. Noto‘g‘ri: I know him for ten years. To‘g‘risi: I've known him for ten years.

scenes.title: For yoki since?
board: 3) We've known each other ___ we were kids.
scenes.say: For or since? One: I've worked here blank 2020. Two: she's been ill blank three days. Three: we've known each other blank we were kids. Four: he blank live here blank ten years.
scenes.say_native: Bo‘sh joylarni to‘ldiring. Birinchisida 2020 — nuqta. Ikkinchisida three days — muddat. Uchinchisida “we were kids” — nuqta. To‘rtinchisida fe’l ham, for yoki since ham kerak. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say_uz: For yoki since? Bir: 2020 dan beri shu yerda ishlayman. Ikki: u uch kundan beri kasal. Uch: bolaligimizdan beri bir-birimizni bilamiz. To‘rt: u o‘n yildan beri shu yerda yashaydi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: One: since. Two: for. Three: since. Four: he has lived here for ten years.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir — since 2020. Ikki — for three days. Uch — since we were kids. To‘rt — “has lived”, “for ten years”. Agar to‘rtinchida “lives” degan bo‘lsangiz, xatoni eslang: muddat hozirgacha davom etsa, present perfect.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: since. Ikki: for. Uch: since. To‘rt: has lived, for.

scenes.title: Just
scenes.say: I've just finished. She has just left. They've just arrived. Just goes between have and the past participle.
scenes.say_native: Endi uchta muhim so‘z: just, already, yet. “Just” — hozirgina, juda yaqinda. Joyi doim have va uchinchi shakl orasida: “I’ve just finished”. Voqea hozirgina bo‘lgan, ammo natijasi hozir ko‘rinib turibdi. O‘zbekchada “hozirgina tugatdim” deymiz, bu yerda ham “hozirgina” so‘zi bor, lekin fe’l oddiy o‘tgan zamonda. Inglizchada esa perfect.
scenes.say_uz: Hozirgina tugatdim. U hozirgina ketdi. Ular hozirgina yetib kelishdi. Just have va V3 orasida turadi.

scenes.title: Already
board: Gap oxirida ham mumkin: I've eaten already.
scenes.say: I've already eaten. Have you already finished? She has already called him. Already means earlier than expected.
scenes.say_native: “Already” — allaqachon, ya’ni kutilganidan oldin yoki yetarlicha erta. Ko‘pincha darak gapda ishlatiladi: “I’ve already eaten”. Savolda esa hayrat bildiradi: “Have you already finished?” — allaqachon tugatdingizmi? Joyi odatda have va V3 orasida, rasmiy bo‘lmagan nutqda gap oxirida ham bo‘ladi.
scenes.say_uz: Men allaqachon ovqatlanib bo‘ldim. Allaqachon tugatdingizmi? U unga allaqachon qo‘ng‘iroq qildi.

scenes.title: Yet
board: yet = hali (inkor va savol, GAP OXIRIDA)
scenes.say: I haven't finished yet. Have you called her yet? It hasn't arrived yet. Yet comes at the end, in negatives and questions.
scenes.say_native: “Yet” — hali. U inkor gap va savollarda ishlatiladi va gap oxirida turadi. “I haven’t finished yet” — hali tugatganim yo‘q, lekin tugatishim kutilyapti. “Have you called her yet?” — hali qo‘ng‘iroq qildingizmi? Darak gapda “yet” ishlatilmaydi, u yerda “already”. Esda tuting: darak gapda already, inkor va savolda yet.
scenes.say_uz: Men hali tugatganim yo‘q. Unga hali qo‘ng‘iroq qildingizmi? U hali kelmadi. Yet inkor va savolda, gap oxirida turadi.

scenes.title: Just, already yoki yet?
scenes.say: Just, already or yet? One: I've blank eaten, earlier than expected. Two: has the film started blank? Three: she has blank left, a moment ago. Four: we haven't booked a hotel blank.
scenes.say_native: Just, already yoki yet bilan to‘ldiring. Birinchisi — allaqachon. Ikkinchisi — savol, gap oxirida. Uchinchisi — hozirgina. To‘rtinchisi — inkor. Har birining gapdagi joyiga ham e’tibor bering.
scenes.say_uz: Just, already yoki yet? Bir: allaqachon ovqatlanib bo‘ldim. Ikki: film hali boshlandimi? Uch: u hozirgina ketdi. To‘rt: biz hali mehmonxona band qilmadik.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: One: already. Two: yet. Three: just. Four: yet.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir — already, darak gap. Ikki — yet, savol. Uch — just, hozirgina. To‘rt — yet, inkor. Bu uch so‘zni darak, savol va inkor bo‘yicha esda tuting, shunda xato qilmaysiz.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: already. Ikki: yet. Uch: just. To‘rt: yet.

scenes.title: Amerika varianti
board: US: I just finished. (ko‘pincha past simple)
Already / yet bilan ham: Did you eat yet? (US)
scenes.say: In British English: I've just arrived. In American English people often say: I just arrived. Both are normal.
scenes.say_native: Britaniya ingliz tilida “just”, “already”, “yet” bilan odatda present perfect ishlatiladi. Amerika ingliz tilida esa ko‘pincha past simple: “I just arrived”, “Did you eat yet?”. Bu xato emas, shunchaki variant. Imtihonlarda Britaniya shaklini ishlatganingiz xavfsizroq. Ikkala shaklni tushunsangiz bo‘ldi.
scenes.say_uz: Britaniya tilida: I've just arrived. Amerika tilida ko‘pincha: I just arrived. Ikkalasi ham normal.

scenes.title: Eshiting: sayohat haqida suhbat
board: A: Have you ever been to Japan?
B: No, I haven't, but I've always wanted to go.
B: I've saved some money, but I haven't booked a flight yet.
scenes.say: Have you ever been to Japan? No, I haven't, but I've always wanted to. I've already saved some money, but I haven't booked a flight yet. My friend went there in 2022. She has been twice, and she's just sent me some photos.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Ikki do‘st Yaponiya haqida gaplashmoqda. Present perfect tajriba uchun ishlatilmoqda: “Have you ever been”, “I haven’t, but I’ve always wanted”. Yet va already ham bor. Keyin 2022 aytilganda esa past simple. Zamonlar o‘zgarishiga quloq soling.
scenes.say_uz: Siz hech Yaponiyada bo‘lganmisiz? Yo‘q, lekin doim borishni xohlaganman. Allaqachon biroz pul yig‘dim, lekin hali chipta band qilmadim. Do‘stim 2022 yilda u yerga borgan. U ikki marta bo‘lgan va hozirgina menga rasmlar yubordi.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
board: 1) Has the speaker been to Japan?
4) How many times has her friend been?
scenes.say: Four questions. Has the speaker been to Japan? Has she booked a flight? When did her friend go? How many times has her friend been?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Gapiruvchi Yaponiyada bo‘lganmi? U chipta band qilganmi? Do‘sti qachon borgan? Do‘sti necha marta bo‘lgan? Javoblaringizni to‘liq gap bilan ayting.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta savol. Gapiruvchi Yaponiyada bo‘lganmi? U chipta band qilganmi? Do‘sti qachon borgan? Do‘sti necha marta bo‘lgan?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: No, she hasn't. No, she hasn't booked it yet. Her friend went in 2022. Her friend has been twice.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir — yo‘q, bo‘lmagan. Ikki — yo‘q, hali band qilmagan. Uch — 2022 yilda. To‘rt — ikki marta. E’tibor bering: 2022 deyilganda “went”, “twice” deyilganda esa “has been”.
scenes.say_uz: Yo‘q. Yo‘q, hali band qilmagan. 2022 yilda. Ikki marta.

scenes.title: Natija va tajribani farqlash
board: Natija: I've lost my phone. (hozir yo‘q)
Tajriba: I've lost my phone twice. (umr bo‘yi)

examples.t: I've broken my arm. (now it hurts)
She's read that book three times.
examples.uz: U bu kitobni uch marta o‘qigan.

scenes.say: I've broken my arm, so it hurts now. I've broken my arm twice in my life. She has read that book three times.
scenes.say_native: Natija va tajriba — bir zamonning ikki ma’nosi. “I’ve broken my arm” — qo‘lim hozir ham shikastlangan, bu natija. “I’ve broken my arm twice” — hayotimda ikki marta, bu tajriba. Tajribada ko‘pincha soni aytiladi: once, twice, three times, many times. Ikkala holatda ham aniq vaqt aytilmaydi. Savol bo‘lsa: natijada “What’s happened?”, tajribada “Have you ever ...?”.
scenes.say_uz: Qo‘limni sindirib olganman, hozir og‘riyapti. Hayotimda qo‘limni ikki marta sindirganman. U bu kitobni uch marta o‘qigan.

scenes.title: So far va this week
board: this week / today / this year = hali tugamagan davr
It's the first time + present perfect

examples.t: I've made three mistakes so far.
It's the first time I've flown.

scenes.say: I've made three mistakes so far. I've drunk four coffees today. It's the first time I've flown.
scenes.say_native: Present perfect yana hali tugamagan vaqt bilan keladi. “So far” — hozirgacha. “Today”, “this week”, “this year” — davr hali davom etmoqda: “I’ve drunk four coffees today”. Bundan tashqari “It’s the first time” dan keyin ham present perfect keladi: “It’s the first time I’ve flown”. Lekin kun tugagan bo‘lsa, “yesterday” deb past simple.
scenes.say_uz: Hozirgacha uchta xato qildim. Bugun to‘rtta kofe ichdim. Men birinchi marta uchyapman.

scenes.title: Tajriba yoki natija?
scenes.say: Complete. One: I see that film three times. Two: look, someone break the window. Three: you ever try Thai food? Four: I not finish my essay yet.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapni present perfect bilan to‘ldiring. Birinchisi — tajriba. Ikkinchisi — natija, ko‘z oldingizda. Uchinchisi — savol. To‘rtinchisi — inkor va yet.
scenes.say_uz: To‘ldiring. Bir: bu filmni uch marta ko‘rganman. Ikki: qarang, kimdir oynani sindirgan. Uch: tay taomini hech tatib ko‘rganmisiz? To‘rt: insho hali tugatmadim.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: One: I have seen. Two: has broken. Three: have you ever tried. Four: I haven't finished.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir — “have seen”. Ikki — “has broken”, someone uchinchi shaxs. Uch — “Have you ever tried”. To‘rt — “haven’t finished”. Hammasini to‘g‘ri topgan bo‘lsangiz, present perfect’ning asosiy ma’nolarini tushundingiz.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: have seen. Ikki: has broken. Uch: have you ever tried. To‘rt: haven't finished.

scenes.title: Savol va qisqa javob
board: ✗ Have you ever been there? — Yes, I been.
✓ Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
✗ Did you ever see him? (tajriba) → ✓ Have you ever seen him?
scenes.say: Short answers use have. Yes, I have. No, I haven't. Not: Yes, I been.
scenes.say_native: Qisqa javoblarda yordamchi fe’l takrorlanadi: “Yes, I have”, “No, I haven’t”. “Yes, I been” deyish xato. Yana bir xato: tajriba haqida so‘rayotganda “Did you ever see him?” — bu noto‘g‘ri, to‘g‘risi “Have you ever seen him?”. Chunki biz hayot davomidagi tajribani so‘rayapmiz. Faqat aniq vaqt bo‘lsa past simple: “Did you see him yesterday?”.
scenes.say_uz: Qisqa javoblarda have takrorlanadi: Yes, I have. No, I haven't. Yes, I been deb aytilmaydi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: kuchsiz shakllar
scenes.say: In natural speech, have is weak: /əv/. I've been there sounds like: /aɪv bɪn ðeə/. We stress the main verb, not the auxiliary.
scenes.say_native: Tez nutqda “have” kuchsiz: /əv/ yoki /həv/. “I’ve been there” — /aɪv bɪn ðeə/ kabi eshitiladi. Urg‘u asosiy fe’lga tushadi. “Been” ham odatda kuchsiz: /bɪn/. Lekin qisqa javobda “Yes, I have” da “have” kuchli: /hæv/. Bu juda muhim — eshitganingizda adashib qolmaslik uchun “have” ni qisqa va kuchsiz eshitishga odatlaning.
scenes.say_uz: Tez nutqda have kuchsiz aytiladi: /əv/. I've been there tez gapda /aɪv bɪn ðeə/ kabi eshitiladi. Urg‘u asosiy fe’lga tushadi.

scenes.title: Takrorlang
scenes.say: I've never been there. She's just left. Have you eaten yet? We've lived here for years.
scenes.say_native: Gaplarni takrorlang. Yordamchi fe’lni qisqa aytib, asosiy so‘zga urg‘u bering: never, left, eaten, years. Ritm tekis va tez bo‘lsin.
scenes.say_uz: Takrorlang: men hech u yerda bo‘lmaganman. U hozirgina ketdi. Ovqatlandingizmi? Biz yillardan beri shu yerda yashaymiz.

scenes.title: Tekshirish
scenes.say: I've never been there. She's just left. Have you eaten yet? We've lived here for years. Stress the meaning words.
scenes.say_native: Tekshirib ko‘ring: urg‘u mazmunli so‘zlarda. Yordamchi fe’llar esa deyarli yo‘qolib ketgandek. Agar har bir so‘zni bir xil kuch bilan aytgan bo‘lsangiz, bu o‘zbek tili ritmining ta’siri. Ingliz tilida kuchli va kuchsiz bo‘g‘inlar almashadi. Ushbu gaplarni yana ikki-uch marta aytib ko‘ring.
scenes.say_uz: Urg‘u mazmunli so‘zlarga tushadi, yordamchi fe’llar kuchsiz aytiladi.

scenes.title: Eshiting: ish suhbati
board: Interviewer: How long have you worked in marketing?
Anna: For six years. I've worked at two companies.
Anna: I've managed a team of five, and I've just finished a big project.
Interviewer: Have you used our software?
Anna: Not yet, but I'm a fast learner.
scenes.say: How long have you worked in marketing? For six years. I've worked at two companies. I've managed a team of five people, and I've just finished a big project. Have you used our software? Not yet, but I'm a fast learner.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog — ish suhbati. Bu present perfect uchun eng tipik vaziyat: tajriba haqida gapirasiz. Tinglang: “How long have you worked”, “for six years”, “I’ve managed”, “just finished”, “not yet”. Hammasi bugun o‘rgangan narsalar.
scenes.say_uz: Marketingda qancha vaqtdan beri ishlaysiz? Olti yildan beri. Ikkita kompaniyada ishlaganman. Besh kishilik jamoaga boshchilik qilganman va hozirgina katta loyihani tugatdim. Bizning dasturdan foydalanganmisiz? Hali yo‘q, lekin tez o‘rganaman.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 1) How long has Anna worked in marketing?
2) How many companies has she worked at?
scenes.say: Four questions. How long has Anna worked in marketing? How many companies has she worked at? What has she just finished? Has she used the software?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Anna marketingda qancha vaqtdan beri ishlaydi? Nechta kompaniyada ishlagan? Hozirgina nimani tugatgan? Dasturdan foydalanganmi? To‘liq gap bilan javob bering.
scenes.say_uz: Anna marketingda qancha ishlaydi? Nechta kompaniyada ishlagan? Hozirgina nimani tugatgan? Dasturdan foydalanganmi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: For six years. Two companies. A big project. No, not yet.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir — olti yil, for six years. Ikki — ikkita kompaniya. Uch — katta loyihani. To‘rt — yo‘q, hali emas. Ish suhbatida ham, kundalik muloqotda ham shu zamon kerak bo‘ladi.
scenes.say_uz: Olti yildan beri. Ikkita. Katta loyiha. Yo‘q, hali emas.

scenes.title: Hikoyaga o‘tish
board: I've been to Egypt. I went in 2021 and I loved it.

examples.t: I've been to Egypt. I went in 2021.
I've seen that film. It was great.
examples.uz: Men u filmni ko‘rganman. U ajoyib edi.

scenes.say: I've been to Egypt. I went in 2021, and I loved it. Start with the perfect, then give details in the past simple.
scenes.say_native: Ingliz tilida tajriba haqida gapirganda odatiy naqsh: avval present perfect bilan xabar berasiz, keyin tafsilotni past simple bilan aytasiz. “I’ve been to Egypt” — umumiy tajriba. “I went in 2021 and I loved it” — aniq vaqt va tafsilot. Shunday qilib ikkala zamon bir-birini to‘ldiradi. Bu naqsh suhbatda juda keng tarqalgan.
scenes.say_uz: Men Misrda bo‘lganman. 2021 yilda borganman va menga juda yoqqan. Avval perfect, keyin tafsilot uchun past simple.

scenes.title: O‘zingiz gapiring
board: 1) Three things you've done in your life
4) One thing you haven't done yet
scenes.say: Your turn. Tell me about your experience. Use have, never, already and yet.
scenes.say_native: Endi navbat sizda. O‘ttiz soniya o‘zingiz haqingizda gapiring. Hayotingizda qilgan uchta ishni, hech qachon qilmagan bir ishni, bugun allaqachon qilgan ishni va hali qilmagan ishni ayting. Present perfect’ni ishlating, keyin bir tafsilotni past simple bilan qo‘shing.
scenes.say_uz: Navbat sizda. Tajribangiz haqida gapiring: have, never, already, yet’dan foydalaning.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: I haven't called my aunt yet.
scenes.say: I've visited five countries, and I went to Turkey last year. I've never eaten snails. I've already had lunch today. I haven't called my aunt yet.
scenes.say_native: Namuna javob mana. “I’ve visited five countries, and I went to Turkey last year” — avval tajriba, keyin tafsilot past simple’da. “I’ve never eaten snails.” “I’ve already had lunch today.” “I haven’t called my aunt yet.” Agar sizniki ham shunday bo‘lgan bo‘lsa, ajoyib. Bo‘lmasa, bir marta qayta gapirib ko‘ring.
scenes.say_uz: Beshta davlatda bo‘lganman, o‘tgan yili Turkiyaga borganman. Hech qachon shilliqqurt yemaganman. Bugun allaqachon tushlik qildim. Xolamga hali qo‘ng‘iroq qilmadim.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
scenes.say: Today we studied the present perfect: result and experience, for and since, and just, already and yet. Remember: if you say when, use the past simple.
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Bir: present perfect — have yoki has va uchinchi shakl. Ikki: u natija va hayot tajribasini bildiradi, vaqt aytilmaydi. Uch: for bilan muddat, since bilan nuqta, hozirgacha davom etsa perfect, hozirgi zamon emas. To‘rt: just, already va yet. Besh: aniq vaqt aytilsa, past simple. Shu besh narsani eslab qolsangiz, bu zamon sizga qiyin tuyulmaydi.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun present perfect’ni o‘rgandik: natija va tajriba, for va since, just, already va yet. Aniq vaqt aytilsa, past simple ishlating.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Use present perfect + one past simple detail
scenes.say: Your homework: describe six changes in your life over the last five years. Use the present perfect, and add one detail in the past simple.
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: so‘nggi besh yildagi hayotingizdagi oltita o‘zgarishni ta’riflang. Masalan, “I’ve changed my job”, “I’ve moved to a new city”. Har bir gapda present perfect ishlating va kamida bittasiga aniq vaqtli tafsilotni past simple bilan qo‘shing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: oltita gap, hammasida to‘g‘ri have yoki has va uchinchi shakl. Keyingi darsda o‘tmishdagi davomli harakat va hikoya tuzishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: so‘nggi besh yildagi oltita o‘zgarishni present perfect bilan ta’riflang, bitta tafsilotni past simple bilan qo‘shing.

homework_uz: So‘nggi besh yildagi hayotingizdagi oltita o‘zgarishni ta’riflang. Har bir gapda present perfect (have/has + V3) ishlating va kamida bittasiga aniq vaqtli tafsilotni past simple bilan qo‘shing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: oltita to‘g‘ri gap.

quiz.why_uz: 2019 — aniq vaqt, past simple: I went.
Since hozirgacha davom etsa, present perfect: I've lived.
For three hours — hozirgacha davom etgan jarayon: has been waiting.

quiz.q: Tom isn't here. He ___ to Paris.
quiz.why_uz: Tom hali qaytmagan, shuning uchun has gone.
Inkor gapda gap oxirida yet keladi.
Hayot tajribasi savoli: Have you ever tried?

options: I know him for ten years.
I have known him for ten years.
I knew him for ten years now.
I am knowing him ten years.
quiz.why_uz: For + muddat hozirgacha: have known; know holat fe’li.
Qisqa javobda yordamchi fe’l takrorlanadi: Yes, I have.
